verses.text: “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct, and the grave is ready for me.
lines: “My spirit is consumed.
My days are extinct,
and the grave is ready for me.

verses.text: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.
lines: Surely there are mockers with me.
My eye dwells on their provocation.

verses.text: “Now give a pledge. Be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?
lines: “Now give a pledge. Be collateral for me with yourself.
Who is there who will strike hands with me?

verses.text: For you have hidden their heart from understanding, Therefore you will not exalt them.
lines: For you have hidden their heart from understanding,
Therefore you will not exalt them.

verses.text: He who denounces his friends for plunder, Even the eyes of his children will fail.
lines: He who denounces his friends for plunder,
Even the eyes of his children will fail.

verses.text: “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.
lines: “But he has made me a byword of the people.
They spit in my face.

verses.text: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.
lines: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow.
All my members are as a shadow.

verses.text: Upright men will be astonished at this. The innocent will stir himself up against the godless.
lines: Upright men will be astonished at this.
The innocent will stir himself up against the godless.

verses.text: Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.
lines: Yet the righteous will hold to his way.
He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.

verses.text: But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.
lines: But as for you all, come back.
I will not find a wise man among you.

verses.text: My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.
lines: My days are past.
My plans are broken off,
as are the thoughts of my heart.

verses.text: They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.
lines: They change the night into day,
saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.

verses.text: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,
lines: If I look for Sheol as my house,
if I have spread my couch in the darkness,

verses.text: if I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father;’ to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘My sister,’
lines: if I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father;’
to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘My sister,’

verses.text: where then is my hope? as for my hope, who will see it?
lines: where then is my hope?
as for my hope, who will see it?

verses.text: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”
lines: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol,
or descend together into the dust?”
